I can determine the SMILES string only after analyzing the experimental data for the unknown sample. Could you please provide any of the following information?

- ¹H NMR data (chemical‑shift values, multiplicities, integration)  
- ¹³C NMR data (chemical‑shift values)  
- IR spectrum (key absorption bands)  
- Mass‑spectrometry data (molecular‑ion m/z, notable fragments)  
- A brief description of the compound (physical state, odor, known functional groups, etc.)

With those details I’ll be able to deduce the structure and give you the correct SMILES notation.
